text: Why don't you tell me about the Dear Lord? Auntie Bogart says I'm going to be a preacher. Can I be a preacher? Can I preach about the Dear Lord?” “Oh, please wait till my generation has stopped rebelling before yours starts in!” “What's a generation?” “It's a ray in the illumination of the spirit.” “That's foolish.” He was a serious and literal person, and rather humorless. She kissed his frown, and marveled: “I am running away from my husband, after liking a Swedish ne'er-do-well and expressing immoral opinions, just as in a romantic story.
